cardOverview.overviewText: A World Safari card from RBL offering zero forex markup, global lounge access, and travel rewards for frequent international travelers.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: 4 complimentary golf games and 12 complimentary golf lessons annually (1 per month), along with a 50% discount on green fees after the complimentary visits.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Customers receive travel insurance cover worth up to USD 50,000 for international travels (including the USA and Canada, excluding the country of residence), covering emergency medical expenses (USD 50,000), flight delay (USD 250), lost baggage (USD 200), lost passport (USD 300), and personal liability (USD 10,000).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to RBL Bank Customer Care at 1800 102 6222 or email rblcare@rblbank.com.
